n1.text: What are you actually asking of the graph?

options.label: Is it reachable / how many groups

n2.text: Do the edges have different weights?

options.label: No — every edge costs the same

r-bfs.detail: FIFO queue guarantees the first time you reach a node is by the fewest edges. O(V+E).

r-dijkstra.detail: BFS with a priority queue ordered by cumulative cost. O((V+E) log V). Requires non-negative weights.

r-bellman.detail: Relax every edge V-1 times; O(V·E). Handles negative weights and detects negative cycles.

r-dfs.detail: Either works for reachability. Start a fresh traversal from each unvisited node; the number of starts is the number of components.

r-topo.detail: Kahn's algorithm with in-degrees, or DFS recording nodes as they finish and reversing. Both detect cycles, which mean no valid ordering exists.

r-backtrack.detail: Explore, record, undo. Prune as early as possible — enumeration without pruning is exponential.
